name: Hotel Chadstone Melbourne MGallery by Sofitel
positioning: Five-star MGallery hotel (officially Hotel Chadstone Melbourne - MGallery Collection) connected to Chadstone, the largest mall in the Southern Hemisphere, 17km from Melbourne CBD
best_for: Shoppers who want a hotel connected to Chadstone
Travelers who want a spa stay with views over Melbourne

facts.text: The hotel is connected to Chadstone, a shopping, dining, lifestyle and entertainment destination.
Chadstone is the largest mall in the Southern Hemisphere.
The hotel is located 17km from Melbourne CBD.
The hotel has views of the Melbourne skyline, Port Phillip Bay and the Dandenong Ranges.
The hotel describes itself as embodying Melbourne's embrace of innovative designers and artisan culture.
Rooms are vaguely Art Deco, with Sofitel MyBeds, dusty-pink headboards and extra-deep soaking tubs.
Guest rooms are stocked with toiletries by Balmain.
Holism, the hotel's spa, offers LED light therapy alongside traditional treatments.
The hotel is ECO Certified through Ecotourism Australia's certification program.
Altus is an onsite bar and restaurant with an upscale-European menu.
The hotel offers day use rooms.

considerations.text: The hotel is 17km from Melbourne CBD, and Chadstone is not well-served by public transport, so guests should be prepared to take taxis or Ubers into central Melbourne.
The hotel offers valet parking for guests who rent a car.
WhataHotel notes the shopping center location may lack traditional hotel ambiance.
